3fccf913600c.name: TeslaZoa
3fccf913600c.text: Elon Musk responded with “Interesting” to an analysis of a potential Tesla–SpaceX merger. Brett Winton of ARK Invest suggested that a roughly 30% acquisition premium for Tesla shares could equalize the expected benefits for both shareholder groups by 2031.
3fccf913600c.note: First stab at deal math: ARK frames the premium Tesla holders would need.

3fccf913600c.name: Sandeep Vig
3fccf913600c.text: Elon Musk called a potential Tesla–SpaceX merger “a good idea” on SpaceX’s earnings call. Both boards have formed special committees of independent directors, with Musk saying he is a “conflicted party”…
3fccf913600c.note: Process angle: independent special committees because Musk is conflicted on both sides.

3fccf913600c.name: Byron York
3fccf913600c.text: From @politico: "SpaceX is by far the dominant player in the rocket business and indispensable to the military, dwarfing competitors and accounting for 85% of U.S. launches in 2025."
3fccf913600c.note: Political lens on SpaceX's scale, relevant to any regulatory review of a combination.

857b61bdc6be.text: Benioff pays a 58% premium for Braze. $5.66B in cash. Braze closed Monday at $30.04. On Tuesday Salesforce offered $47.50 a share, in cash… Still below Braze’s 2021 IPO price of $65.
857b61bdc6be.note: Premium vs. IPO price: a take-under relative to 2021 even at 58% up.

857b61bdc6be.name: The Financial Wolverine
857b61bdc6be.text: If Salesforce is paying $47.50 cash for Braze, why won't the market pay $47.50 for it today? … Braze jumped 51.7% to $45.57
857b61bdc6be.note: Explains the merger-arb spread: time value plus deal-close risk.

0ce87dd7f89e.note: The capital-markets twist: a non-voting class to fund AI, M&A and pay.

0ce87dd7f89e.text: Meta raises 2026 capex to $135–145 bln, to issue non‑voting share class
0ce87dd7f89e.note: Capex guide raised again; most-shared headline post on the print.

0ce87dd7f89e.name: 4lex
0ce87dd7f89e.text: A great quarter/strong guide (w/ asterisk of heavy incoming share issuance to fund AI capex) from META = stock implodes. The market is telling the hyperscalers to slow their AI capex significantly.
0ce87dd7f89e.note: Bear read: why a beat sold off, and what it signals for AI capex.

0ce87dd7f89e.name: Kai
0ce87dd7f89e.text: $META beat… despite a $9.9B legal charge. Revenue $64.6B vs $63.3B expected. Adjusted EPS $7.40, or $3.83 including the charge. Q4 guide $73B to $76B. Capex record $34.9B. Capex exceeded cash from operations
0ce87dd7f89e.note: Key numbers incl. the legal charge and capex above operating cash flow.

4064a0b8c647.name: Kakashii
4064a0b8c647.text: Nscale, which filed its S-1 and is looking to start its roadshow soon, is a former lessor of data center infrastructure to crypto mining companies that de facto made the shift to AI by 2025…
4064a0b8c647.note: Skeptic's view on Nscale ahead of its IPO roadshow; widely shared.

4064a0b8c647.name: Jim Liu
4064a0b8c647.text: Why $CRWV isn't a NVDA DSX Partner. $NVDA listed four clouds $NBIS, $IREN, NScale and Lambda as DSX partners and why not CRWV?…

2ff622bcefe0.name: WOLF Trading
2ff622bcefe0.text: Dell Technologies $DELL is up 4% today in sympathy with Super Micro $SMCI following its preliminary earnings update. Supermicro raised its quarterly revenue outlook to $18.5-19.5B from $14.5-15.5B, with gross margin guidance also increasing to 12-12.5%.
2ff622bcefe0.note: The raise in numbers, plus the read-across to Dell.

2ff622bcefe0.name: Deedee
2ff622bcefe0.text: $SMCI rose 12.4% to $36.51 after Super Micro raised its first-quarter sales estimate… Gross margin estimate 12.0% to 12.5%, was 10.4% to 10.8%. 6.7x forward earnings, 0.61x sales
2ff622bcefe0.note: Valuation context: still cheap on forward P/E and sales.

4951d17a18e4.name: Joker Capital
4951d17a18e4.text: Meta Q3 scorecard, expected vs actual: Revenue $63.3B → $64.6B (up 26% YoY). EPS ex-legal charge $6.54 → $7.40. 2026 capex $130–145B → $135–145B (high end unchanged). After hours briefly up more than 4%. Verdict: a beat.
4951d17a18e4.note: The clean beat/miss scorecard; note the raised capex floor is what markets fixated on.

4951d17a18e4.name: Gryphon Investment Advisors
4951d17a18e4.text: The AI capital-expenditure cycle has crossed from an equity debate into a credit question. Meta's first negative free cash flow since 2012, a capex floor lifted to $135bn and Jensen Huang's warning that AI cloud providers lack working capital drove the Philadelphia semis index lower.
4951d17a18e4.note: Ties Meta's print to the semis selloff: negative FCF turns AI capex into a credit story.

c0f87efb8196.name: Bilaal - BD investing
c0f87efb8196.text: Bill Ackman extremely bullish on Netflix: calls it a super high-quality business, a “high-growth utility” nobody wants to cancel, trading around 18x earnings with 15–20% earnings growth expected for years.
c0f87efb8196.note: A big-name long defending NFLX after the post-earnings derating.

c0f87efb8196.name: Daniel Brooks
c0f87efb8196.text: NFLX: an earnings beat isn't enough. Q3 revenue $12.87B and EPS $0.87, but weaker Q4 guidance and a reduced 2026 ad revenue outlook weighed on sentiment. Stock near the recent $64.10 low.
c0f87efb8196.note: Why the stock fell despite a beat: guide and ad-revenue cut.

c0f87efb8196.name: Michael Sikand
c0f87efb8196.text: Seeing Netflix in the mid $60s at 17x earnings is kind of insane. I can't believe it trades for under 20x earnings.
c0f87efb8196.note: Valuation take: NFLX now at a sub-20x multiple.

8d7c14a45da6.name: Rebellionaire

8d7c14a45da6.note: Contrasts SpaceX's profitable quarter with Tesla's longer-dated story ahead of the merger talk.

8d7c14a45da6.name: Ryan B. Leslie
8d7c14a45da6.text: SpaceX results this week: revenue $14.6B (up 161% YoY), net income $4.4B vs a ~$1.1B loss a year earlier, operating income ~$2.8B.
8d7c14a45da6.note: Quick recap of SpaceX's headline Q3 numbers.

8d7c14a45da6.name: zerohedge
8d7c14a45da6.text: Premarket movers: Mag 7 mixed. Tower companies gain and wireless carriers slide after SpaceX was said to be seeking access to cell sites for a wireless network.
8d7c14a45da6.note: Market read-through today: SpaceX's wireless push is moving towers and carriers.

b06d89a152c8.name: John Intel
b06d89a152c8.text: Why is the market worried? CoreWeave's unsecured debt came under heavy pressure, with yields around 15%, raising fears that financing for the broader AI buildout could be cracking. Why does Barclays think that's the wrong conclusion?
b06d89a152c8.note: Both sides of the AI-credit scare: CoreWeave bonds near 15% vs Barclays' pushback.

b06d89a152c8.name: PL
b06d89a152c8.text: AI is profitable, it needs infra → infra needs capex → capex needs all of hyperscaler FCF and starts going into debt → debt affects credit → debt glut pushes corporate bond yields up → (we are here).
b06d89a152c8.note: Simple chain of how AI capex turns into a bond-market problem.

b06d89a152c8.name: Gryphon Investment Advisors

Meta's first negative free cash flow since 2012, a capex floor lifted to $135bn and Jensen Huang's warning that AI cloud providers lack working capital drove the Philadelphia semis index lower.

5027d66e229c.name: InvestmentGuru
5027d66e229c.text: GOOG at $315–320 is one of the cleanest bets into earnings next week. Alphabet reports Wednesday, Oct 28 after the close, and the stock has been sold for two straight weeks, not on its own numbers but on sector fear around AI.
5027d66e229c.note: Bull setup into the Oct 28 print after two weeks of sector-driven selling.

5027d66e229c.name: YUKI CAPITAL
5027d66e229c.text: Alphabet fell about 2% after Sundar Pichai said on a podcast the company would prioritize compute for DeepMind, passing up some short-term cloud revenue. Cloud is what I'll watch in earnings.
5027d66e229c.note: The compute-allocation worry: DeepMind vs Google Cloud capacity.

3e3eb695599f.name: Pejjy

3e3eb695599f.note: Most-engaged bull recap of Tesla's call despite the stock drop.

3e3eb695599f.name: Mamnoon
3e3eb695599f.text: Tesla's solid Q3 beat quickly faded as Musk tempered expectations on robotics, robotaxi and chipmaking; shares swung to a 3.1% after-hours drop.
3e3eb695599f.note: Why the stock fell: Musk cooled the AI and robot narrative.

LRCX.text: Lam Research reports current-quarter guidance that missed elevated expectations. Shares fell nearly 9%… CFO Doug Bettinger said near-term supply constraints limited the outlook.
LRCX.note: Why it's down: the guide, capped by supply constraints, not demand.

SPCX.text: SpaceX wants at least 80,000 cell sites across the US and is negotiating with Crown Castle, per Bloomberg. The goal is a 4th national wireless carrier alongside AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile. SpaceX already locked in roughly $8 billion of low-band 800 MHz spectrum.
SPCX.note: The big SpaceX story today: a terrestrial wireless push on top of Starlink.

SPCX.name: Mason Jones
SPCX.text: There are about 158,500 cell towers in the country. SpaceX wants half of them. Satellites can reach your phone outside, not inside an office or garage, which is why SpaceX bought 800 MHz spectrum and is now shopping for towers.
SPCX.note: Plain explanation of why SpaceX needs towers, not just satellites.

MU.name: Tradenometry
MU.text: Who pays for the AI build-out, and what it takes for semis to rerate: chips sold off hard while most stocks rose. The market isn't questioning AI demand. It's asking whether the spending can be financed and whether supplier profits last.
MU.note: Frames the semis selloff as a financing question, not a demand one.

0001437749-26-031534.name: Michael Lofranco
0001437749-26-031534.text: Trump Media CEO Kevin McGurn still believes the TAE merger can close before year-end, while acknowledging completion could extend into early next year as the companies work through SEC review.
0001437749-26-031534.note: Timing update on the S-4 deal: SEC review could push closing into 2027.
